manifest_text:
[package]
name = "aspose-jmap-foss"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Open-source JMAP (RFC 8620 Core / RFC 8621 Mail + EmailSubmission) client library with an Aspose.Email-style API."
license = "MIT"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.JMAP-FOSS-for-Rust"
homepage = "https://github.com/aspose-email-foss/Aspose.JMAP-FOSS-for-Rust"
keywords = ["jmap", "email", "rfc8621", "client", "mail"]
categories = ["email", "network-programming", "api-bindings"]
authors = ["Aspose <jmap@aspose.com>"]

[lib]
name = "aspose_jmap_foss"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
ureq = "2"
percent-encoding = "2"
